answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in beacon, checked in hollow, and meadow shows each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 635 identities would post 1380 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
